source_state_availability_assumption: causal feature construction uses current and earlier samples; replay timestamps each saved state at its source-grid time before configured network delay; inference computation latency is not measured

causal_no_lookahead_preflight.first_sample_derivative_rule: forward and yaw acceleration are initialized to zero at the first grid sample
causal_no_lookahead_preflight.future_perturbation_rule: changing samples from index 6 onward leaves features through index 5 unchanged
